# Competitor and adjacent-product onboarding teardown (research notes for Metis)

Prepared: 2 Oct 2026. All sources accessed 2 Oct 2026 unless stated.

## Method and evidence legend

- Primary sources first: vendor help centers, release notes, product pages, vendor newsrooms. Third-party teardowns are labelled [3P].
- Every claim carries `[Source: URL, date]`. Date = publication or last-updated date shown by the source; where none is shown, "accessed 2 Oct 2026".
- Help-center articles on Zendesk (monday.com, ClickUp, Wrike) were read through the public Help Center JSON API (`/api/v2/help_center/en-us/articles/<id>.json`), which returns `created_at` / `updated_at`; those timestamps are quoted as "created / updated".
- Pages that could not be opened, or claims that only appeared in search-engine summaries, are marked `[Unverified - confirm before applying]`.
- Quoted text is verbatim except that em and en dashes in the original were replaced by a colon or comma (house style for this document).
- Bottleneck tags used throughout: CONFIG (configuration), PEOPLE (people and access), DATA (existing data), LEARN (learning).

---

## 1. monday.com

**Onboarding flow (signup to first value)**
- Signup starts with work email only; profile questions shown one at a time; a full-screen prompt invites teammates "you'd like to explore the monday app with"; author says the flow takes "around a minute". [3P] [Source: https://goodux.appcues.com/blog/monday-app-signup-user-invite, undated, accessed 2 Oct 2026]
- Post-signup home: dismissible checklist cards and a banner asking users to invite their team. [3P] [Source: https://www.candu.ai/blog/monday-com-onboarding-flow, undated, accessed 2 Oct 2026]
- Official getting-started guidance: "Everything starts with a board"; "To get started faster, you can begin with a template and customize it". Product now named "monday AI work platform". [Source: https://support.monday.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005305649, updated 23 Sep 2026]

**AI setup features**
- monday magic: "transforms a simple prompt into a ready-to-use, customized work solution"; "within minutes, monday magic will build a fully functional workspace ready for immediate use. Within the workspace, it will create boards with columns (including AI blocks), dashboards, and forms." [Source: https://support.monday.com/hc/en-us/articles/27740074397842-Get-started-with-monday-magic, created 30 Jun 2025, updated 24 Sep 2026]
  - Entry points: left-panel "+ > Magic AI solution", sidekick, template center "Start building", new workspace "Personalize with AI", home page. [same source]
  - Preview before commit: "you will see a preview ... browse through the different boards and dashboards, as well as view the columns and demo information"; changes are requested in the chat; "View in my workspace" commits. [same source]
  - Clarifying questions: if the prompt is "too short or unclear", "monday magic enters a discovery mode where it suggests improvements, asks clarifying questions, and requests confirmation before building your solution." Also an "Optimize prompt" option. [same source]
  - File input: "you can upload files like Excel, CSV, PDF, or DOCX, and monday magic will turn them into a structured solution." Can @mention existing boards and docs as context. [same source]
  - Scope: board relations supported; "can create and delete automations during setup ... editing existing automations may require manual changes"; subitems supported. [same source]
  - Learning aids generated with the solution: a walkthrough video, a "Solution overview" document, and a "Getting Started" guide. [same source]
  - No account needed to try: "You can explore and generate a solution ... but you'll need an existing or new monday.com account to publish". Free, no usage limits stated; generated features on Pro/Enterprise get a two-week trial. [same source]
  - Launch context (July 2025 press release with monday vibe and sidekick): [Unverified - confirm before applying] (ir.monday.com returned HTTP 429 on 2 Oct 2026).
- Portfolio solution (Enterprise): "+ > New Portfolio" creates a portfolio board; "Add project > Create new project" creates a project board instantly connected, with a Resource planner on by default; AI "Portfolio Risk Insights" generates a daily risk list; one-click AI portfolio report. [Source: https://support.monday.com/hc/en-us/articles/13337066797202-The-portfolio-solution, updated 1 Sep 2026]
- Portfolio at scale (beta): up to 5,000 projects per portfolio, up to 20 managed templates per portfolio. [Source: https://support.monday.com/hc/en-us/articles/37031730483474, created 7 Jul 2026]

**Templates and governance at scale**
- Managed templates (Enterprise): a workspace or board becomes a "master template"; instances "automatically receive supported changes from the managed template whenever changes are published"; 20 per Enterprise account by default. [Source: https://support.monday.com/hc/en-us/articles/18229256953234-Managed-templates-on-monday-com, created 10 Apr 2024, updated 25 Aug 2026]

**People and access**
- Published "secure configuration checklist": hosting region, authorized domain (prevents users creating separate accounts in the domain), SSO (SAML 2.0), 2FA, IP restrictions, SCIM, session duration, custom account roles, workspace and board permissions. A checklist, not an automated flow. [Source: https://support.monday.com/hc/en-us/articles/34336185460498, created 26 Mar 2026]

**Import options**: Jira Server, Basecamp, Excel (CRM) importers listed in help center; Jira Cloud two-way sync app (created 1 Jun 2026). [Source: monday Help Center search API results, accessed 2 Oct 2026; individual import articles not opened]

**Vendor time-to-value claims (PPM)**: comparison table: traditional enterprise PPM "6 to 12 months requiring specialized consultants" vs monday "2 to 4 weeks, run by internal business teams"; adoption "40 to 60%" vs "85%+"; "Total Economic Impact study by Forrester showing a payback period of less than four months"; "enterprise clients frequently report onboarding in weeks, sometimes as few as two". Vendor marketing, not independent. [Source: https://monday.com/blog/project-management/project-portfolio-management-software/, published 27 Jan 2026, modified 30 Aug 2026]

## 2. Asana

**Onboarding flow**
- Recorded web onboarding (July 2024): sign up, check inbox, verification email, log-in details, select role, select category, objective, enter project name, add tasks, select view, invite teammate, free trial details, then the project. [3P] [Source: https://pageflows.com/post/desktop-web/onboarding/asana/, recording July 2024]

**AI setup features**
- Smart projects (June 2024): "Just simply enter a project name, and AI will create a suggested description, sections, and custom fields. You can edit AI's suggestions as needed before finalizing the project." Flow: Create > Project > Blank Project > name > "Set up". Starter, Advanced, Enterprise, Enterprise+. [Source: https://forum.asana.com/t/828378, posted 7 Jun 2024]
- AI Studio: no-code builder for "smart workflows"; "Available in early access from today" (22 Oct 2024). [3P press] [Source: https://siliconangle.com/2024/10/22/asanas-ai-studio-promises-transform-work-management-smart-workflows-task-automation/, 22 Oct 2024]. Current page: three steps "Set the trigger, Define actions (plain-language instructions), Deploy", plus a template gallery; on Starter, Advanced, Enterprise, Enterprise+ with Basic/Plus/Pro tiers. [Source: https://asana.com/product/ai/ai-studio, accessed 2 Oct 2026]
- Smart Workflow Gallery: "A suite of prebuilt, AI-powered workflows designed to help your teams get started using AI"; categories at launch include "Operations & PMO: Strategic Planning, Work Intake, Goal Management"; "Deploy a workflow from the gallery in minutes"; rollout "Starting this May and rolling out through July". [Source: https://asana.com/inside-asana/smart-workflow-gallery, 6 May 2025]
- AI Teammates (beta) in Fall 2025 release, plus AI risk reports, timesheets and budgets add-on, goal custom fields. [Source: https://forum.asana.com/t/1108498, posted 20 Nov 2025]. Original announcement date 25 Sep 2025 [Unverified - confirm before applying] (investors.asana.com returned Access Denied).

**Import options**: CSV import exists [Unverified - help.asana.com article not opened].

**Metis relevance**: Smart projects is the closest "name to structure" pattern but stops at description, sections and fields; no lifecycle or governance generation found.

## 3. ClickUp

**Onboarding flow**
- "After email verification, follow the series of onboarding modals that guide you through creating your Workspace." Setup guide then recommends arranging the Hierarchy before importing, and lists set-up options: start from scratch, Solutions (by team or use case), Templates, Professional Services. Security recommendations: 2FA, SSO, session management. [Source: https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/9563779819031-Set-up-your-team-s-Workspace, updated 29 Sep 2026]
- Paid human onboarding: ClickUp Assist, "Two hours per month of one-on-one sessions with a ClickUp expert". [Source: https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/21867311353879, updated 19 Sep 2026]

**AI setup features**
- Brain can create Tasks, Subtasks, Docs and Pages, Reminders, Lists, and "Interactive slides, dashboards, and prototypes". [Source: https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/19953994898711-Create-items-with-Brain-AI, updated 29 Sep 2026]
- Brain AI tools include "Create List: Create new Lists in Spaces, Folders, or Subfolders" and "Create Custom Field: Create a new Custom Field at the Workspace, Space, Folder, Subfolder, or List level". [Source: https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/33032484272023-What-are-ClickUp-Brain-AI-tools, created 24 Jun 2025, updated 1 Oct 2026]
- No help article found for generating a whole Space hierarchy from one prompt. [absence in sources reviewed, not proof of absence]
- Super Agent Builder: "Chat with the builder to explain what you need, and answer its questions"; requires the AI ClickApp to be activated. [Source: https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/37033397273111-Create-a-Super-Agent, created 15 Dec 2025]
- ClickUp Accelerator: packages of Super Agents "designed and built by our experts" and installed in the workspace (e.g., Project Status Summarizer, Risk Log Summarizer, Project Kickoff Summarizer). [Source: https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/37714610164375-ClickUp-Accelerator, created 16 Jan 2026]

**Import options** (help-center titles): Wrike, Todoist, Asana, Spreadsheets, Notion, Basecamp, Confluence, Monday.com, Trello, Slack, Jira. [Source: help.clickup.com search API results, accessed 2 Oct 2026]
- Asana importer: map projects; for people, "Invite new people: Email an invite to people who don't match a ClickUp user by email address", or "Don't import new people"; map Asana sections to ClickUp statuses; "import time can vary from 1 minute to a few hours". [Source: https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6311064163479-Import-from-Asana, updated 23 Sep 2026]
- monday importer: "Create your structure in ClickUp first"; boards import into Folders and Lists; custom fields, dropdowns, assignees, comments imported. [Source: https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6311012229527-Import-from-Monday-com, updated 19 Sep 2026]

## 4. Smartsheet

**AI setup features**
- Smart Assist announced 5 Nov 2025 (ENGAGE): "helps users accelerate time-to-value by creating workspaces and projects from simple outlines, activating automations and answering questions"; then in private beta. [Source: https://www.smartsheet.com/content-center/news/smartsheet-debuts-intelligent-work-management-unifying-ai-data-and-people, 5 Nov 2025]
- Smart Assist GA: "Create assets: Set up new workspaces, folders, and sheets with columns and rows; Add sample data"; can "instantly generate dashboards"; plans Pro, Business, Enterprise, Advanced Work Management. [Source: https://www.smartsheet.com/content-center/work-smarter-and-move-faster-smart-assist-now-generally-available, 3 Jun 2026]
- Same Nov 2025 release: Portfolios in Early Adopter Program, "general availability expected Q1 2026"; Project Manager Smart Agent. [Source: Nov 2025 release above]

**Templates and provisioning (Control Center, premium)**
- Blueprint = source templates (sheets, reports, dashboards) plus optional intake sheet, summary rollup, WorkApps, Resource Management panel, profile data, naming rules; built via a multi-screen wizard; requires Admin or Primary Lead on Business, Enterprise or Advanced Work Management. [Source: https://help.smartsheet.com/articles/2478876-scc-create-blueprint, accessed 2 Oct 2026]
- Automated provisioning: mark intake-sheet rows "Approved" to trigger project creation from the blueprint; "You can only use automated provisioning on blueprints with intake sheets"; "You can't edit a blueprint if you've enabled automation". [Source: https://help.smartsheet.com/learning-track/control-center/automated-provisioning, accessed 2 Oct 2026]

**Metis relevance**: closest analogue to Metis "framework published, then projects generated from it": approval of an intake row provisions a governed project from a blueprint. Blueprint authoring itself is manual.

## 5. Wrike

**Onboarding / learning**
- Collaborator onboarding (Oct 2025): "A Get started with Wrike checklist to help learn Wrike by using Wrike" and "Walk-me nudges to help explain Wrike hierarchy"; Business and above. [Source: https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/35699906070039, created 17 Oct 2025]

**AI setup features**
- AI Space Setup (Wrike Labs): "Create a new Wrike Space simply by describing how your team works. AI will suggest the best way to organize projects and folders." [Source: https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/community/posts/34627676023447-Guide-Wrike-AI-Features, posted 2 Sep 2025, updated 15 Jan 2026]
- Build an AI agent in chat: "Wrike asks follow-up questions, uses your space's existing setup to suggest the right configuration, and lets you review everything before anything runs"; "Wrike uses your space's existing custom fields, workflows, and item types"; "If Wrike can't build exactly what you ask for, it explains the limit and suggests an alternative"; Business, Pinnacle, Apex. [Source: https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/36703536722194-Build-an-AI-Agent-in-Chat, created 25 Jun 2026]
- AI automation rule creation (Labs, Oct 2025): describe in plain language, "AI will generate a ready-to-use rule, recommend the best template, and pre-fill the necessary fields". Widget Generator builds dashboard widgets from natural language. [Source: https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/35699906070039, created 17 Oct 2025]
- AI request form generator: "Add your custom prompt or select from ready-made templates, then click Create Draft". [Source: https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/31214266322834, created 20 Nov 2025]
- Agent example: "Blueprint-based creation: Generate a standard project structure from a blueprint automatically upon request submission." [Source: https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/37087792729234, created 9 Jul 2026]

**Templates**
- Custom Space Templates (Business+): "Account owners and admins can save Spaces as templates"; May 2026 adds Effort, planned fees, planned cost, Budget, workflow transitions to what templates preserve. [Sources: https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/31214266322834, 20 Nov 2025; https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/35673266706578, 18 May 2026]
- Blueprints for tasks, folders and projects (long-standing). [Source: https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/360013445394-Blueprints-in-Wrike, updated 21 Sep 2026]
- Federated space configuration: "the ability to publish teams' space configurations for the use of other teams in the same Wrike account". [Source: https://www.wrike.com/blog/product-launch-collaborate-2025/, 8 Oct 2025]

**Vendor claim**: "More than three-quarters of our enterprise customers have already embraced new governance and reporting features ... dramatically accelerating new-user onboarding and cutting administration time by up to 95%." [Source: same blog, 8 Oct 2025]

**Import options**: MS Project files, XLS (including creating folders and projects via XLS). [Source: https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500005220122, updated 24 Sep 2026; article titles from help-center search]

## 6. Notion

**AI setup features**
- Notion 3.0 Agents (18 Sep 2025): "capable of over 20 minutes of multi-step actions"; example "building a launch plan, breaking it into tasks, assigning them, and even drafting docs"; "updating or creating hundreds of pages at once". [Source: https://www.notion.com/help/notion-agent, accessed 2 Oct 2026]
- Turning PDFs or CSVs into databases via the agent: [Unverified - confirm before applying].

**Import options**: Evernote, Trello, Quip, Dropbox Paper, Hackpad, Asana, Confluence, Monday.com, Google Docs; files txt, md, docx, csv, html, pdf, zip; from Trello "Power-Ups, automations, and permissions don't carry over and need to be rebuilt". [Source: https://www.notion.com/help/import-data-into-notion, accessed 2 Oct 2026]

## 8. Microsoft Planner and Project

- Planner Agent (formerly Project Manager agent) in Planner: "Plan creation (available in premium plans only): The Planner Agent can generate tasks for your plan based on a given goal and relevant files"; also task execution and status reports; GA; requires Microsoft Copilot license. [Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/planner/copilot/frequently-asked-questions-about-planner-agent, accessed 2 Oct 2026]
- Planner Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot: "Create plans from scratch", "Generate plans from Word, Excel, or PowerPoint files", "Organize new work around goals and objectives", "Review drafts before creation ... review and approve content before it is created"; editing limited to Name, Progress, Due date, Start date, Priority, Plan name. [Source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/planner/what-can-you-do-with-planner-agent-in-copilot, accessed 2 Oct 2026]
- GA notice MC1323264: "generate structured plans that include goals, buckets, task hierarchies"; rollout mid to late June 2026; Microsoft 365 Copilot license. [Source: https://mc.merill.net/message/MC1323264 (mirror of Microsoft 365 Message Center), published 26 May 2026]
- Project Online retired 30 Sep 2026; Microsoft points customers to Planner, Project Server Subscription Edition, or Project Operations; "After Project Online is retired, you will no longer be able to access your projects or any associated data within the service". [Source: https://mc.merill.net/message/MC1478955 (mirror of MC1478955), published 24 Sep 2026]. Market note for Metis: a population of PPM customers needs a new home right now.
- Project for the web retirement (Aug 2025): [Unverified - confirm before applying].

- Create a Jira space with Rovo: "link documents, upload local files, or select suggested work from your Teamwork Graph"; "add links to Confluence pages and Loom videos, or upload files (like CSVs, images, or PDFs)"; "Review the suggested configuration, including the space name, key, work types, statuses, and views. [Source: https://support.atlassian.com/jira-software-cloud/docs/create-work-items-with-rovo/, accessed 2 Oct 2026]

## 12. ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)

- Quick start guide (three phases): Understand, Prepare, Configure. Implementation paths: ServiceNow Expert Services, Implementation Partner, Self-implementation. [Source: https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-articles/quick-start-guide-for-strategic-portfolio-management/ta-p/2990613, published 16 Jul 2024, updated 11 Aug 2026]
- Prepare phase asks customers to decide before configuring: org structure and partitions; key users and roles ("Each SPM module requires named groups before configuration can proceed"); fiscal settings ("Fiscal calendar type is configured once and cannot be changed after funds have been allocated"), funding frequency, system currency ("the default is USD if left blank"), cost types; governance ("SPM ships with pre-built demand and project playbooks"), approval stages, status report cadence, working hours and holiday calendars per region. [same source]
- Setup Hub: "your single location for all SPM administration"; "guided setup experience with progress tracking built in"; "Every step can be revisited ... Nothing locks you out of a prior stage"; "AI-assisted: an AI assistant helps you create groups and assign roles conversationally as you work through setup." [same source]
- Welcome guide lists "Now Assist for Setup" and "ServiceNow Otto for SPM" among capabilities. [Source: https://www.servicenow.com/community/spm-articles/strategic-portfolio-management-spm-welcome-guide/ta-p/2368193, published 31 Oct 2022, updated 12 Aug 2026]
- Now Assist for SPM (Zurich, July 2025 delta deck): enhanced email project summary; support for OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini LLMs. [Source: https://www.servicenow.com/community/s/cgfwn76974/attachments/cgfwn76974/strategic-portfolio-management-kb/1404/1/Zurich_July%202025%20SPM%20Delta%20Deck%20.pdf, July 2025]
- AI project-plan generation and a "Configuration Console" in 2026 store releases; rename to "Otto" at Knowledge 2026: [Unverified - confirm before applying].
- No duration estimate published in the quick start guide.

**Metis relevance**: this is the closest public description of what an enterprise PPM tenant must decide; it confirms Metis' list (org structure, roles, fiscal calendar, currency, governance, calendars) and flags fiscal calendar as irreversible.

## 14. Celoxis

## 18. Cross-cutting patterns (evidence-backed) and implications for Metis

Each implication states whether it is approach-changing for the Metis requirements and the smallest way to apply it.

1. **Prompt or document to a previewed draft, refined by chat, then committed** (monday magic; Jira Create with Rovo; Smartsheet Smart Assist; Planner Agent draft cards; Confluence Create with Rovo). Approach-changing: yes, it replaces the wizard as the primary setup surface. Smallest application: one "describe your company / upload your PMO handbook" step that produces a draft workspace (profile, option lists, lifecycle draft) in preview state; nothing is live until the admin commits.
2. **Discovery questions only when input is insufficient** (monday magic "discovery mode"; Wrike agent builder follow-up questions that reuse existing configuration; ClickUp Super Agent Builder). Approach-changing: yes for UX. Smallest application: the generator asks only for missing mandatory facts (fiscal year start, currency, gate approver roles) instead of a fixed questionnaire.
3. **Lifecycle-aware AI suggestions** (Planview ProjectAdvantage suggested deliverables across phases and gates). Approach-changing: no, it validates Metis' deliverable framework idea. Smallest application: when a project is created, suggest deliverables and WBS fragments per stage from the published framework.
4. **Template blueprints that provision and propagate** (Smartsheet Control Center approval-triggered provisioning; monday managed templates; Wrike custom space templates and federated configuration). Approach-changing: no. Smallest application: approved intake creates the project from the published lifecycle; framework version updates propagate to non-started projects.
5. **Importers with identity mapping and reversible imports** (Linear: map, create or skip users; bulk delete within a window; ClickUp: invite unmatched emails, map sections to statuses). Approach-changing: no. Smallest application: importer maps people by email and statuses to system states, with one-click undo for a limited window.
6. **One setup hub with progress, revisitable steps, conversational group/role creation, and early warning on irreversible choices** (ServiceNow Setup Hub; fiscal calendar locked after funds allocation). Approach-changing: yes for information architecture. Smallest application: a single setup checklist page with completion indicator; AI drafts roles and teams from a pasted org list; irreversible settings flagged before commit.
7. **Zero-entry capture from systems of record** (Attio, Affinity). Approach-changing: possibly; transfer to PPM is an inference, not observed in any PPM product reviewed. Smallest application: derive people, teams and working calendars from IdP or SCIM groups and calendars instead of manual entry.
8. **AI enablement is an explicit admin step everywhere** (Atlassian "enable beta AI features"; ClickUp AI ClickApp; Wrike "Generative AI enabled"; Clarity Vaia activation plus LLM integration). Approach-changing: no. Smallest application: the tenant AI policy is a single default-on decision with scoped data access, set during tenant creation.

**Gaps observed (absence in sources reviewed, not proof of absence)**
- No reviewed product generates a governed stage-gate framework (gates with approvers, quorum, decision options, SLAs, entry and exit criteria, conditional rules) from a prompt or an uploaded PMO process document. Closest: Planview ProjectAdvantage (deliverables only), ServiceNow pre-built playbooks, Smartsheet hand-built blueprints.
- AI builders stop at structure: Notion Agent explicitly cannot manage member roles or security; Jira space generation covers name, key, work types, statuses, views; monday magic edits to existing automations "may require manual changes". No reviewed AI configures SSO, domains, roles per workspace and project, and AI policy end to end.
- No reviewed AI builder validates a governance configuration before publish (for example, a gate with no approver or an unreachable stage). Review exists only as human preview.
- Importers move tasks and issues; none reviewed imports capacity per person and period, allocations, or budgets. Project Online retired 30 Sep 2026, so orphaned PPM data exists now.
- Published PPM time-to-value is weeks to months (section 17); no reviewed PPM vendor claims a sub-hour governed setup.
